functions.name: mock_result_valid
functions.arguments: j jsonb, kind text, revision text

functions.name: mock_transition_digest
functions.arguments: order_ref text, rev bigint, kind text, command text, control text, occurred timestamp with time zone

constraints.name: mock_command_processing_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((released_by_control_id IS NULL) OR ((state = 'completed'::text) AND (held_by_control_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: mock_controls_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((action = 'capture_order'::text) AND (scenario = 'normal'::text)) OR ((action = 'release_command'::text) AND (scenario = 'normal'::text)) OR ((action = 'emit_test_event'::text) AND (scenario = ANY (ARRAY['capture_at_created'::text, 'capture_before_created_1us'::text, 'capture_before_expiry_1us'::text, 'capture_at_expiry'::text, 'capture_future_6s'::text, 'amount_plus_one'::text, 'duplicate_capture_other_transaction'::text, 'same_revision_conflict'::text, 'refund_unsupported'::text, 'dispute_unsupported'::text]))) OR ((action = 'arm_fault'::text) AND (scenario = ANY (ARRAY['before_command_commit_disconnect_once'::text, 'after_command_commit_drop_reply_once'::text, 'after_query_snapshot_commit_drop_reply_once'::text, 'hold_checkout_before_effect'::text, 'hold_cancel_before_effect'::text, 'before_callback_send_once'::text])))))

constraints.name: mock_delivery_observations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((outcome = 'ack'::text) AND (http_status = ANY (ARRAY[200, 202])) AND (error_code IS NULL) AND (receipt_data IS NOT NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'failed'::text) AND (error_code IS NOT NULL) AND (error_code = ANY (ARRAY['network'::text, 'timeout'::text, 'auth'::text, 'protocol'::text, 'environment'::text, 'temporary'::text, 'permanent'::text])) AND (receipt_data IS NULL))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: mock_delivery_observations_event_id_generation_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (event_id, generation) REFERENCES mock_delivery_attempts(event_id, generation)

constraints.name: mock_environment_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((app_schema_oid <> mock_schema_oid) AND (app_schema_oid <> receiver_schema_oid) AND (mock_schema_oid <> receiver_schema_oid)))

constraints.name: mock_fault_plans_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((boundary = 'after_query_snapshot_commit_drop_reply_once'::text) AND (target_kind = 'query'::text) AND mock_uuid(target_id)) OR ((boundary = 'before_callback_send_once'::text) AND (target_kind = 'callback'::text) AND mock_ref(target_id)) OR ((boundary <> ALL (ARRAY['after_query_snapshot_commit_drop_reply_once'::text, 'before_callback_send_once'::text])) AND (target_kind = 'command'::text) AND mock_uuid(target_id))))

constraints.name: mock_order_transitions_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((fact_digest = mock_transition_digest(merchant_order_id, revision, kind, command_id, control_operation_id, occurred_at)))

constraints.name: mock_orders_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((amount IS NULL) AND (created_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at IS NULL) AND (checkout_ref IS NULL) AND (state = 'closed'::text) AND (revision = 1)) OR ((amount IS NOT NULL) AND (created_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (expires_at = (created_at + '00:15:00'::interval)) AND (checkout_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (checkout_ref ~ '^checkout:[0-9a-f-]{36}$'::text) AND mock_uuid(substr(checkout_ref, 10)))) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: mock_orders_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((created_at IS NULL) OR ((created_at >= '0001-01-01 08:05:43+08:05:43'::timestamp with time zone) AND (expires_at < '10000-01-01 08:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone))))

constraints.name: mock_orders_environment_id_merchant_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id, merchant_id) REFERENCES mock_environment(environment_id, merchant_id)

constraints.name: mock_signing_keys_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((not_before >= '0001-01-01 08:05:43+08:05:43'::timestamp with time zone) AND (not_after < '10000-01-01 08:00:00+08'::timestamp with time zone)))

constraints.name: mock_signing_keys_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (((not_before <> '0001-01-01 08:05:43+08:05:43'::timestamp with time zone) AND (not_after <> '0001-01-01 08:05:43+08:05:43'::timestamp with time zone)))
